interpretation_references.author: Nathan Long, Wizards.Com Boards NetRep
interpretation_references.scope: Animate Dead cannot attach to a returned noncreature God; the Aura falls off and its delayed ability sacrifices that permanent. Protection remains outside this implementation's supported scope.
Fling requires exactly one creature sacrifice, uses its last battlefield power, and allows responses only after the full casting cost is paid.

Crop Rotation requires exactly one land sacrifice as an additional casting cost. Dark Depths has no mana ability; its no-ice state trigger cannot duplicate while waiting, can retrigger after being countered, and requires a successful sacrifice to create Marit Lage. Mystic Remora's cumulative upkeep increases with actual age counters and requires an optional complete payment.
Escape permission, alternative payment, repeated escape and Uro's independent entry benefit and optional land placement.
Bulk Up's power snapshot and Prayer of Binding's optional targeting, early source departure and Aura return.
The Ozolith departure copies, optional all-counter transfer, exact source and target availability.
Aven Courier chooses targets at trigger placement and counter kinds during resolution.
Essence Channeler's printed 2/1 body, gross turn life loss, one trigger per life-gain event, all-kind death snapshot and independent departure copies.
Xolatoyac's printed 6/6 body, targeted flood counter and source-independent Island duration; intrinsic Island mana and retained types.
Counter-conditioned durations can begin at a new resolution after an earlier flood-counter condition ended.
The Earth Crystal's green generic reduction, replacement-aware +1/+1 doubling including entry, positive target division during announcement, and lost illegal-target shares.
Touch the Spirit Realm's optional entry exile, Channel discard cost, exact delayed owner return, token disappearance and early source departure.
